title: Operations, research and launch-playbook requirement evidence proposal

status_policy.implemented: Named local tests/inspection support the stated software or document behavior; external facts remain explicitly listed.
status_policy.partial: Some concrete behavior exists with remaining software/operational acceptance stated.
status_policy.external_gate: Requires specifically missing real accounts, rights, counterparties, people, observations or live environment.
status_policy.research_gate: Optional research/product gate lacks eligible data, licensing, experiments or independent demand.

requirements.title: Requirement traceability
requirements.acceptance: All source areas and unique later-phase directions map to status and evidence; unverified external gates remain explicit.
requirements.verified_behavior: Revised standalone blueprint and original 263-ID register preserve all unique source headings, phases and appendices; separate evidence keeps unverified gates visible.
remaining_acceptance: Root must merge all assessor proposals into the final status register; no pending row implies completion.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Policy rollback
requirements.acceptance: Authorized staff can compare and restore a prior policy without losing intervening audit history.
requirements.verified_behavior: Immutable reception-policy snapshots support compare and authorized restore as a new version with reason; stale versions and cross-tenant access reject.
remaining_acceptance: Catalog and calendar records have separate histories and are not rolled back by reception-policy restore.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Clinic policy UAT
requirements.acceptance: Publishing production configuration requires completed clinic-specific synthetic booking/error/transfer checks.
requirements.verified_behavior: Production publication and AI admission require current-clinic/current-mode UAT fingerprint, five checks, five references, active owner/admin reviewer and 30-day expiry. Drift invalidates approval.
remaining_acceptance: The gate enforces a named attestation; it does not automatically prove referenced checks ran.
external_dependencies: Actual clinic reviewer, truthful test execution, carrier/clinical/legal approvals remain separate.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Disruption handling
requirements.acceptance: Late arrival, provider postponement and emergency closure create explicit revised states and notices.
requirements.verified_behavior: Late-arrival/provider-delay/closure records preserve actual appointments, block new affected capacity, release unused holds and create explicit impacts, tasks and notices.
remaining_acceptance: Replacement time requires explicit staff decision and a valid current slot.
external_dependencies: Real staff must contact affected patients and verify arrangements.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Manual correction
requirements.acceptance: Authorized staff can correct patient/service/time with conflict checks and an audit reason.
requirements.verified_behavior: Staff name/contact/service/time corrections are scoped, versioned, idempotent and atomic; conflict preserves originals, history is encrypted and price change requires acceptance.
remaining_acceptance: Changed deposits and pending-payment moves require separate reviewed financial/rebooking handling.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Recurrence and bundles
requirements.acceptance: Recurring/session-series and multi-resource bundles have explicit supported limits and per-instance outcomes.
requirements.verified_behavior: Single appointments support configured durations, buffers and named single-capacity resource bundles with conflict checks.
remaining_acceptance: Arbitrary recurring/session-series scheduling and per-instance multi-booking saga outcomes are not implemented.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Durable outbox leasing
requirements.acceptance: Workers atomically claim jobs, recover expired leases and retain capped attempts/backoff/dead letters.
requirements.verified_behavior: Durable claims, capped retry/backoff and expired-dispatch reconciliation preserve unknown outcomes without blind resends.
remaining_acceptance: A crashed in-flight submission becomes UNKNOWN and needs reconciliation.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Logical notice deduplication
requirements.acceptance: Appointment revision/template/purpose forms one logical dispatch; external uncertainty is reconciled rather than blindly resent.
requirements.verified_behavior: Durable dedupe keys and appointment revision checks prevent duplicate logical notices; unknown sends cannot be retried as if unsent.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: SMS adapter
requirements.acceptance: Configured domestic gateway accepts approved templates, handles structured errors and returns provider receipt identity.
requirements.verified_behavior: Approved Kavenegar client supports structured requests/errors, OTP template and receipt identity; demo worker never transmits.
remaining_acceptance: Native live account/template/receipt behavior has not been verified.
external_dependencies: Approved SMS account, actual contract and delivery tests.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Delivery receipt states
requirements.acceptance: Queued/accepted/delivered/failed/unknown remain distinct; replay/out-of-order receipts are safe.
requirements.verified_behavior: Queued/in-flight/submitted/delivered/failed/unknown/simulated remain distinct; receipt dedupe and delivered-terminal precedence are tested.
remaining_acceptance: Real delivery truth depends on authenticated provider evidence.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Receipt authentication
requirements.acceptance: Webhook authentication follows provider capabilities, or trusted server polling verifies status.
requirements.verified_behavior: Timestamped HMAC adapter webhook and server-side provider status client exist; generic signature is explicitly not claimed as native vendor format.
remaining_acceptance: Actual vendor translation/polling schedule and credentials need an approved integration.
external_dependencies: Provider-specific receipt/authentication contract.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Suppression and preference check
requirements.acceptance: Consent, channel preference and opt-out are checked at send time; withdrawals stop queued outreach.
requirements.verified_behavior: Purpose/privacy tombstones override grants and explicit SMS channel denial blocks enrollment, scheduling and dispatch. Revocation suppresses eligible unsent work.
remaining_acceptance: Already in-flight external messages cannot truthfully be recalled.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Quiet hours
requirements.acceptance: Configured Tehran windows including overnight ranges defer messages/calls appropriately.
requirements.verified_behavior: Configured Tehran quiet windows including overnight ranges defer supported SMS and capacity offers.
remaining_acceptance: Outbound voice reminders are disabled, so their quiet-hour behavior is not implemented.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Reminder scheduling
requirements.acceptance: Tenant-configured offsets such as 24 hours generate notices only for current eligible appointments.
requirements.verified_behavior: Validated published offsets schedule the latest due reminder once without bursting all missed offsets.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Stale reminder invalidation
requirements.acceptance: Cancel/reschedule/revision changes invalidate old reminder messages before dispatch.
requirements.verified_behavior: Dispatch rechecks current booking status/revision/start, offset, opt-in and suppression; stale reminders are suppressed.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Confirmation response
requirements.acceptance: Signed/authorized patient confirmation or decline updates the right booking and obeys cancellation policy.
requirements.verified_behavior: Opaque capability/hash authorizes one appointment revision; confirmation records intent only, eligible decline cancels, late decline opens review. Replay/expiry/erasure/disruption checks apply.
remaining_acceptance: Intent to attend is never actual attendance.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Attempt caps
requirements.acceptance: Repeated delivery failure/non-response cannot create endless SMS or outbound voice attempts.
requirements.verified_behavior: SMS retry caps, bounded outbox attempts and waitlist daily/lifetime/per-run limits bound supported work.
remaining_acceptance: Selective outbound voice attempts remain disabled.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Selective voice reminders
requirements.acceptance: Opt-in outbound reminders such as 6-hour follow-up honor routes, quiet hours, budget and cap.
requirements.verified_behavior: Selective outbound voice dialing is explicitly disabled and policy reports outbound_voice_enabled=false.
remaining_acceptance: No invented carrier API or fake dial result is shipped.
external_dependencies: Approved outbound carrier capability, routes/consent/billing and real outcome tests.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Sensitive notice minimization
requirements.acceptance: Shared-phone and voicemail messages avoid sensitive specialty/procedure details by default.
requirements.verified_behavior: Default templates contain minimal administrative wording; followup avoids individualized aftercare and disruption notices invent no new times.
remaining_acceptance: No voicemail delivery path or universal shared-phone/sensitivity classifier exists.
external_dependencies: Clinic-approved wording and recipient suitability review.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Follow-up cadence
requirements.acceptance: Clinician-approved recurring/post-visit outreach is tenant-published, purpose-specific and revocable.
requirements.verified_behavior: Published followup cadence needs a separately authorized current clinician, attended visit and explicit enrollment consent; dispatch rechecks version/membership/channel/withdrawal.
remaining_acceptance: Template is administrative, not individualized medical advice.
external_dependencies: Real staff qualifications and actual clinic clinical approval.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Human retry workflow
requirements.acceptance: Staff see failed notices separately from booking status and can retry with audit and duplicate safeguards.
requirements.verified_behavior: Known FAILED messages below caps can be explicitly retried with audit; UNKNOWN/in-flight/submitted/delivered/simulated messages cannot be blindly requeued.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Opt-in enrollment
requirements.acceptance: Members specify provider/service/date/time windows, travel lead time and contact permission.
requirements.verified_behavior: Opt-in enrollment validates scoped provider/service, date/local-minute windows, travel lead and contact permission.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Fair candidate selection
requirements.acceptance: Eligible candidates follow transparent configured priority/first-come rules without sensitive discriminatory ranking.
requirements.verified_behavior: Oldest eligible first is transparent, filtered by date/time/travel/consent/contact caps; sensitive ranking is absent.
remaining_acceptance: Supported priority is first-come eligibility; arbitrary custom ranking is not advertised.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Genuine capacity event
requirements.acceptance: Waitlist begins only after an authoritative cancellation/release creates available capacity.
requirements.verified_behavior: Opt-in automatic offers consume durable release events, recheck current calendar and acquire a real hold; an intervening booking defeats the offer.
remaining_acceptance: Manual staff offers may use another genuinely available interval; only automatic offers require a release event.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Time-limited offer
requirements.acceptance: Offer ownership, expiry and optional supported hold are durable and visible.
requirements.verified_behavior: Owner, encrypted/hash capability, expiry and actual hold persist; staff resumes saved offers and reads current safe deposit terms.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Atomic acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Two simultaneous acceptances create at most one reservation; patient and offer authorization are checked.
requirements.verified_behavior: Acceptance validates capability/staff scope and current eligibility under tenant serialization; unique booking key and held capacity prevent duplicate reservation. Actual deposits require explicit current terms.
remaining_acceptance: Direct duplicate acceptance, exclusive holds and calendar contention are separately tested; success may be PENDING_PAYMENT rather than confirmed.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Offer expiry/release
requirements.acceptance: Expired/canceled offers release capacity and cannot be revived by a late click.
requirements.verified_behavior: Expiry/rejection/withdrawal revokes eligibility and releases occupancy; late clicks and stale texts cannot revive offers.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Stop after fulfillment
requirements.acceptance: Filling a slot or opt-out cancels remaining outreach and pending candidates.
requirements.verified_behavior: Acceptance marks fulfillment; purpose withdrawal cancels eligible candidates/offers and queued notices without silently canceling appointments.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Complete offer audit
requirements.acceptance: Selection, contact attempt, expiry, acceptance, rejection and final booking remain traceable.
requirements.verified_behavior: Offer/contact attempts/acceptance/expiry/rejection/withdrawal have durable records and audit links to final booking.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Published deposit policy
requirements.acceptance: Deposits are disabled until amount, currency, expiry, cancellation and refund terms are published.
requirements.verified_behavior: Actual deposits require enabled published per-clinic terms, currency and hold limit plus explicit current acceptance before booking; demo version zero is labeled synthetic.
remaining_acceptance: Published operator text is not a legal determination.
external_dependencies: Actual clinic terms and consumer/payment obligations require authorized review.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Integer money and units
requirements.acceptance: Amounts use explicit integer IRR/Toman units and exact gateway conversion.
requirements.verified_behavior: Integer Toman amounts convert exactly to IRR by ten and the provider payload explicitly identifies IRR.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Payment intent linkage
requirements.acceptance: Intent is tied to tenant, merchant, booking/hold, amount, currency and expiry with unique operation identity.
requirements.verified_behavior: Explicit tenant mapping and intent snapshot pin provider/merchant identity hash, alias, sandbox, booking, amount/currencies, terms and expiry; changed/missing bindings fail before verification.
remaining_acceptance: Keep old aliases unchanged while their intents are pending.
external_dependencies: Real merchant authorization/ownership and gateway readiness remain unverified.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Hosted gateway link
requirements.acceptance: Provider-approved link is returned without collecting card secrets in app/call.
requirements.verified_behavior: Approved configured gateway returns a hosted link without collecting card secrets; synthetic demo returns no real payment URL.
remaining_acceptance: No real merchant payment was executed.
external_dependencies: Provider approval/account and actual hosted-link contract tests.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Server settlement verification
requirements.acceptance: Native signature/verification checks merchant, amount, currency, booking and trusted settlement status.
requirements.verified_behavior: Callbacks verify server-side using pinned merchant, exact amount/currency and current locked payment/calendar state; changed binding fails before provider construction.
remaining_acceptance: Provider responses were exercised through mock transport and synthetic boundaries.
external_dependencies: Live gateway account/API verification remains a launch gate.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Replay and forgery defense
requirements.acceptance: Forged/replayed callbacks cannot confirm unpaid or duplicated appointments.
requirements.verified_behavior: Unverified callbacks cannot settle, and replay preserves terminal post-refund state and unique booking identity.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Expiry and late payment
requirements.acceptance: Unpaid holds expire; late settlement creates reconciliation/refund or a newly verified slot, never conflicting confirmation.
requirements.verified_behavior: Unpaid capacity expires and late verification becomes refund review without resurrecting canceled/expired/started appointments.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Refund ledger
requirements.acceptance: Full/partial/refused/pending/settled refund states are idempotent and reconcile with provider truth.
requirements.verified_behavior: Bounded full/partial reservation, refusal, pending reconciliation, evidenced failure/completion and unique transfer reference checks are idempotent; reasons are encrypted.
remaining_acceptance: Code records authorized evidence but does not execute refunds or authenticate an entered bank reference independently.
external_dependencies: Actual transfer execution, receipts and reconciliation responsibility.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Payment/reschedule race
requirements.acceptance: Concurrent cancellation/reschedule/settlement preserves resource and financial invariants.
requirements.verified_behavior: Tenant-first serialization/current locked state and expiry checks preserve calendar/payment transitions; concurrent refund reservation/completion cannot overreserve or lose partials.
remaining_acceptance: Root PostgreSQL evidence supplies separate engine validation beyond these local transactional tests.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Dispute and chargeback
requirements.acceptance: Staff can track disputes and corrective ledger entries without rewriting original financial facts.
requirements.verified_behavior: Validated scoped dispute lifecycle appends one negative principal adjustment for a loss and never rewrites original settlement; refund budget accounts for known loss.
remaining_acceptance: Actual dispute adjudication/reference validity remains external staff work.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Optional installment/price extensions
requirements.acceptance: Installment/dynamic-price behavior remains disabled until terms and complete supported gateway workflows exist.
requirements.verified_behavior: Installment and automatic dynamic-price gateway behavior is disabled; fixed tenant prices/deposits and explicit correction acceptance are supported.
remaining_acceptance: Introducing either option requires approved terms, product decision and complete provider workflow.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Task atomic ownership
requirements.acceptance: Accept/claim prevents accidental competing handlers; reassignment requires permission and audit.
requirements.verified_behavior: Serialized/versioned case claims yield one owner; scoped active members may be assigned and legacy resolution obeys the same ownership policy.
remaining_acceptance: Actual staffing coverage is not established.
external_dependencies: Named staff and measured pickup capacity.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Task lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: Accept, reject/redirect, callback, resolve, reopen and pending status have validated transitions.
requirements.verified_behavior: Claim/reassign/pending/callback/resolve/reopen/reject/redirect validate state, owner, version and receipts; callback time is aware, future and bounded.
remaining_acceptance: Frontend interaction evidence is assessed separately.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Owner daily digest
requirements.acceptance: Digest counts verified bookings, attendance, cancellations, waitlist fills, open cases and actual usage.
requirements.verified_behavior: Owner digest separates verified booking state, scheduled attendance/unknown, cancellation, waitlist fills, all active cases and actual call-duration/cost events.
remaining_acceptance: Historical backlog is not reconstructed; scheduled destination dispatch is separately assessed.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Economics sensitivity
requirements.acceptance: Calculator includes AI/carrier/SMS/infrastructure/humans/support/FX/taxes with explicit assumptions.
requirements.verified_behavior: Decimal calculator supports AI/carrier/SMS/infra/human/support cost categories, units, Toman/IRR/USD, FX/quantity/outcome scenarios and separate invoice tax.
remaining_acceptance: Example figures are assumptions, not supplier prices or observed results.
external_dependencies: Actual invoices, FX convention, staff costs and contract terms.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Booked versus kept value
requirements.acceptance: Report separates gross booked value, kept contribution and estimated causal increment.
requirements.verified_behavior: Booked potential, observed kept contribution, baseline difference and justified incremental contribution remain separate; negative outcomes stay visible.
remaining_acceptance: Causal increment is an explicitly supplied basis, never inferred from booking count.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Baseline and uncertainty
requirements.acceptance: No ROI is invented when baseline, attendance or cost missing; denominators and uncertainty accompany estimates.
requirements.verified_behavior: Missing positive cost/justified increment leaves ROI absent; pilot excludes incomplete/unmatched cohorts and reports intervals plus independence/confounding limitations.
remaining_acceptance: Approximate intervals do not account for repeated-patient/day clustering or prove causality.
external_dependencies: Observed baseline/attendance/cost and defensible study design.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Deduplicated attribution
requirements.acceptance: Repeat callers, displaced bookings and waitlist replacements are not double-counted as recovered demand.
requirements.verified_behavior: Tools never label raw bookings/waitlist fills/baseline differences as recovered demand automatically; playbook requires repeat-caller/displacement accounting.
remaining_acceptance: No automated patient-level causal attribution or cross-channel deduplication study is implemented.
external_dependencies: Authorized inquiry/attendance identities and displacement observations.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Staff workload accounting
requirements.acceptance: Time released distinguishes avoidable labor cost from reassigned work and deducts supervision/rework.
requirements.verified_behavior: Economics separately accepts observed avoidable staff value and extra supervision/rework; templates distinguish reassigned time from savings.
remaining_acceptance: Tools do not measure actual work or automatically classify avoidability/reassignment.
external_dependencies: Observed time study, payroll/shift decisions and supervision cost.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Purpose-specific consent
requirements.acceptance: Processing, recording, QA, marketing, training and cross-border permissions have independent evidence/version.
requirements.verified_behavior: Processing/recording/training configuration and purpose/channel grants are separated; supported outreach withdrawal is independent of erasure and dataset training has rights gates.
remaining_acceptance: Complete independent QA/marketing/cross-border permission workflows are not all implemented.
external_dependencies: Actual controller/purpose/region decisions and permission evidence.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Retention scheduler
requirements.acceptance: Per-purpose expiry acts on records/audio/exports and records deletion evidence and backup-expiry obligations.
requirements.verified_behavior: Jobs expire supported operational records/grants/holds and dataset rights/withdrawals are revalidated; templates address backup expiry obligations.
remaining_acceptance: Universal per-purpose audio/export/backup retention is not fully proven in this owned scope; merge root retention evidence.
external_dependencies: Approved actual schedules and recovery/backup-expiry procedure.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Subject export/correction/deletion
requirements.acceptance: Authorized requests produce scoped results and tombstones without destroying necessary lawful audit.
requirements.verified_behavior: Scoped export/delete/correction covers identities, conversation/challenges, linked staff notes and prior-contact history. Tombstones suppress outreach while active business records enter explicit review.
remaining_acceptance: Financial/lawfully retained records need case-specific retention decisions, not universal compliance claims.
external_dependencies: Authorized request and actual lawful-retention determination.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Data-use revocation
requirements.acceptance: Withdrawal blocks queued outreach/dataset work and new processing for revoked purpose.
requirements.verified_behavior: Purpose tombstones stop queued/new supported outreach; erasure revokes capabilities and holds; current withdrawal invalidates frozen manifests before dataset work.
remaining_acceptance: In-flight messages cannot be recalled; previously trained weights need separate withdrawal impact review.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Text redaction
requirements.acceptance: Logs/traces remove mobile/national IDs and governed names/health/address/payment fields.
requirements.verified_behavior: Controlled templates and IDs minimize logs; new staff/correction/refund free text is encrypted and subject cleanup redacts linked notes.
remaining_acceptance: No complete universal governed-name/health/address/payment text redactor or PII detector is implemented.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Audio redaction separation
requirements.acceptance: Audio segment masking/exclusion is distinct from transcript redaction and requires review evidence.
requirements.verified_behavior: PCM span muting is separate from transcript normalization. Tests prove unchanged bytes outside selected frames, reject invalid spans/metadata and require review/provenance.
remaining_acceptance: Metadata presence does not prove all sensitive speech was identified.
external_dependencies: Qualified human audio/text privacy review and approved corpus rights.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Processor registry
requirements.acceptance: Configured suppliers carry approved regions/purposes/retention and failover eligibility.
requirements.verified_behavior: Configured processors expose purposes/unverified region status; approved-host/processor flags restrict gateways and unapproved fallback.
remaining_acceptance: A complete verified contract/region/retention register is not populated by code.
external_dependencies: Current supplier agreements and region/purpose/retention/fallback decisions.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: No covert monitoring
requirements.acceptance: No passive staff interception or biometric voiceprint feature is enabled by default.
requirements.verified_behavior: No passive staff interception or biometric voiceprint feature is implemented/enabled; optional memory/training are separate gates.
remaining_acceptance: Real deployments must preserve this boundary when adding integrations.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Incident audit minimization
requirements.acceptance: Investigators can reconstruct state/events via IDs without unrestricted clinical recordings.
requirements.verified_behavior: State/event IDs support investigations while sensitive correction/task/refund notes are encrypted and authorized views scoped; cleanup retains categorical history without linked free text.
remaining_acceptance: Actual investigators require assigned authority and minimal evidence access.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Eligibility manifest
requirements.acceptance: Curator rejects samples missing clinic/caller/training/license/retention/region rights.
requirements.verified_behavior: Manifest admission rejects missing clinic/caller/training/license/retention/region/provenance/review evidence and inconsistent hashes.
remaining_acceptance: Presence/type validation cannot prove external legal sufficiency.
external_dependencies: Real eligible corpus and permission documents.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Track and acoustic metadata
requirements.acceptance: Caller/agent tracks, sample rate, codec, timing and source hash are retained for eligible samples.
requirements.verified_behavior: Eligible PCM manifests retain sample rate/channels/duration/codec/source hashes and supplied caller-track metadata.
remaining_acceptance: No live dual-track capture/diarization pipeline or independent source-channel verification is implemented.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Segmentation quality
requirements.acceptance: Candidate 3–15-second caller segments flag overlap/noise and do not imply restored narrowband information.
requirements.verified_behavior: 3–15-second candidate bounds and PCM/redaction layout validation are implemented; narrowband information limits are explicit.
remaining_acceptance: Automatic VAD/overlap/diarization/noise scoring is not implemented.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: PII review provenance
requirements.acceptance: Text/audio redaction and human privacy-review status are mandatory before training eligibility.
requirements.verified_behavior: Text/audio review flags, reviewer/time/provenance and reviewed hashes gate admission; changed post-review bytes refuse publication.
remaining_acceptance: Reviewer fields are not independent proof of actual review quality.
external_dependencies: Qualified privacy reviewers and complete span decisions.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Teacher label QA
requirements.acceptance: Independent teacher outputs and human adjudication distinguish agreement from actual ground truth.
requirements.verified_behavior: Teacher labeling and human adjudication are explicit separate release gates; fictional transcripts are not ground truth.
remaining_acceptance: No multi-teacher/adjudication pipeline was implemented or run.
external_dependencies: Licensed teachers, eligible audio and independent adjudicators.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Duplicate protection
requirements.acceptance: Exact source/segment hashes and split-overlap checks reject duplicates and leakage.
requirements.verified_behavior: Exact source/output hashes reject duplicate audio and split overlap checks reject leaked speaker/tenant/audio groups.
remaining_acceptance: Acoustic near-duplicate recognition is outside exact-hash protection.
requirements.scope: Owned operations/research/documentation evidence; merge deployment/voice/frontend evidence separately.

requirements.title: Speaker/tenant splits
requirements.acceptance: Configured train/validation/test grouping prevents speaker and tenant leakage.
